title: Response contract drift

steps.action: Read the requirement gate and record the chosen deployment/contract before generating runnable assertions.
steps.expected: If a required policy or capability is unavailable, return a Blocked/Unsupported report with the missing input. Do not guess business behavior.
steps.evidence: Resolved contract/policy or exact missing input

steps.action: Load the pinned OpenAPI subset and record version/hash.
steps.evidence: Observed value/status, expected-versus-actual comparison and failing step if any

steps.action: Fetch live OpenAPI and retain retrieval timestamp/hash.
steps.expected: HTTP success and valid spec; unavailable spec yields a retrieval blocker.
steps.evidence: Observed value/status, expected-versus-actual comparison and failing step if any

steps.action: Compare operations used by this project.
steps.expected: Added/removed methods, parameters and response codes reported with JSON paths.
steps.evidence: Observed value/status, expected-versus-actual comparison and failing step if any

steps.action: Compare consumed schema properties, types, required fields and formats.
steps.expected: Meaningful changes distinguished from description/order-only changes.
steps.evidence: Observed value/status, expected-versus-actual comparison and failing step if any

steps.action: Compare owned runtime transaction shape with the applicable pinned response schema.
steps.expected: Numeric date versus date-time string reported as a runtime/spec mismatch even if the live spec has no change.
steps.evidence: Observed value/status, expected-versus-actual comparison and failing step if any

steps.action: Produce drift report with affected case IDs and proposed review actions.
steps.expected: No automatic oracle rewrite, schema coercion or false pass.
steps.evidence: Observed value/status, expected-versus-actual comparison and failing step if any

steps.action: Close browser/API contexts; retain sanitized case evidence and record created resource IDs in a private run manifest.
steps.expected: No global reset or unrelated-account mutation. Closing contexts does not delete server records; scoped deletion is unavailable.
steps.evidence: Sanitized resource manifest and cleanup limitation

setup: Pinned OpenAPI snapshot available; live spec may be unreachable and must then be reported as Blocked.
data: Pinned docs/api schema; live /services/bank/openapi.json; numeric date example retained as known evidence.
acceptance: Separate spec-to-spec drift from runtime-to-spec violation; show concrete paths and affected tests.
completion: All applicable setup and assertion steps pass with recorded evidence. Stop on setup failure and distinguish Blocked from product/assertion failure. Historical result is from the previous implementation run, not execution of this expanded specification.
